name: XXL-JOB Console
description: Manage XXL-JOB tasks, logs and executors with DBX built-in AI and MCP, scoped permissions and confirmed operation previews.
releaseNotes: 0.4.0 adds 22 tools for DBX built-in Agent and external MCP, default-off per-connection permissions, grouped and individual tool controls, and call history. Task and executor writes share expiring one-use previews, confirmation, conflict detection and read-only/account checks. Add task details, contextual AI entry points, bounded logs, saved/override run parameters, loading states and unknown-result handling. Requires DBX 0.6.43+ and Host API ^1.4.0; preserves existing connection identities and Admin 2.3.x/3.4.x profiles, including the 0.3.3 required executor filter fix.
